text: f=~/.config/vlc/vlcrc; mkdir -p ~/.config/vlc; touch $f; sed -i '/^#*qt-bgcone=/d' $f; if grep -q '^\[qt\]' $f; then sed -i '/^\[qt\]/a qt-bgcone=0' $f; else printf '[qt]\nqt-bgcone=0\n' >> $f; fi; grep -n -e '\[qt\]' -e qt-bgcone $f
memo: Rewrote vlcrc so qt-bgcone=0 sits directly under a proper [qt] section header (guards against a section-less file that a config parser couldn't read). Next: crop terminal e11 to confirm output shows '[qt]' then 'qt-bgcone=0'. Do NOT open/Save VLC Preferences afterwards - VLC would rewrite qt-bgcone=1 from memory.
